card.//: Diagnose one card off the generated CardAtlas dumps (Derived artifacts — gitignored, produced on demand; run `nx run mast:run` then `nx run mast:recall-report` first, see docs/design/pipeline-regeneration.md): ports + spans sliced against oracle text, combos, tier/presence, and a diff vs the live GraphQL API. Usage: nx run atlas-diag:card -- --name "Chatterfang, Squirrel General" [--no-api]

find.//: Search/filter cards in the dataset. Usage: nx run atlas-diag:find -- --family sacrifice --side emit  |  -- --query squirrel
